project.name: TMCP skill harvest and recommendation
project.identity: The TMCP skill catalog and harvest surface that turns reusable material into governed recommendations.
project.audience: Operators and agent workflows selecting skills, workflow packs, and reusable patterns.
project.core_loop: Harvest or inspect a candidate, evaluate its fit and safety, recommend or stage it, and preserve the decision evidence.
project.north_star: Reusable capability is selected for a task with explicit provenance, fit, and safety rather than accidental import.

scope.purpose: Evaluate reusable material and recommend task-relevant inputs with provenance, safety, and explicit promotion boundaries.
scope.boundary: Owns the skill packages, harvest and evaluation guidance, and recommendation-facing scripts; packet runtime and distribution release mechanics remain outside this child.
